checks.name: Elbow
checks.detailed_advice: Your front arm extension is excellent! This positioning allows maximum power transfer through the shot. Keep practicing this form.

checks.name: Head
checks.detailed_advice: Great head stability! Your eyes stayed level throughout the shot, which is crucial for tracking the ball and timing. This is textbook technique.

checks.name: BackFoot
checks.detailed_advice: Excellent back foot stability! Your base is solid, allowing proper weight transfer. This foundation is key to generating power.

checks.name: Hips
checks.detailed_advice: Perfect hip rotation! You're generating excellent power through your lower body. This aggressive rotation is exactly what's needed for this shot.

checks.name: Finish
checks.detailed_advice: Your follow-through is incomplete - hands stopping low. This means you're decelerating through the shot, losing power. Practice 'full swing drills' where you exaggerate the follow-through. Your hands should finish HIGH - near or above your opposite shoulder. Think 'throw the bat over your shoulder' (but controlled!).
